compiled_state.description:
## Context / problem

Re-land the review-scanner artifacts reverted after Gerrit change 2612, but do **not** recreate the defect from incident `90c7-c465-4037-42d5`: scanner integration must not enter the required `Verified` hot path. ADR 0114 requires this lane to run advisory first: non-voting, non-blocking, outside `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` `vote.needs`, outside vote normalization, and outside the same workflow run observed by `im-open/workflow-conclusion`. Promotion to voting is out of scope and needs a later ticket after advisory evidence on `main`.

## Scope

Recreate/adapt the reverted scanner integration against current `origin/main`:

- platform scanner manifest and Semgrep hash locks for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64;
- scanner installer plus review-bot Dockerfile integration;
- the relative-prefix Semgrep-link behavior from the scanner change: when called with a relative `.tools/review-scanners` prefix from another working directory, the provisioned `bin/semgrep` link must resolve to an executable target;
- POSIX-`dash`-safe `make scanner-integration` target;
- reusable scanner workflow and mirror CI invocation;
- separate Gerrit advisory workflow `.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml` whose filename contains `gerrit` and `verify` so existing gerrit-to-platform filename dispatch selects it;
- `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` ADR-0114 exception for the intentionally advisory `scanner-integration` mirror job;
- generated `docs/security.md` scanner-lock ownership/update/checksum/recovery narrative;
- regression/static tests for installer integrity, scanner contracts, docs, public exposure, workflow names, mechanism-delta admitted-step parity, advisory wiring, b973 predates guard parity, and dash-safe Make syntax.

Recorded 21-path impact: `infra/compose/review-scanners.lock.json`, `infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-amd64.requirements.txt`, `infra/compose/review-scanners.linux-arm64.requirements.txt`, `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot`, `scripts/install_review_scanners.py`, `Makefile`, `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py`, `tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_conflict_markers.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_public_exposure.py`, `tests/unit/test_code_review_ws5.py`, `.github/workflows/_scanner-integration.yml`, `.github/workflows/test.yml`, `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`, `docs/security.md`, `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py`, `tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py`, `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py`, `.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml`.

## Advisory wiring contract

The Gerrit scanner lane must live in `.github/workflows/gerrit-scanner-verify.yml`, not in `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml`. `gerrit-verify.yaml` must have no `scanner-integration` job, no scanner entry in `vote.needs`, and no scanner entry in vote normalization; the required `vote` job must still cast `Verified +1/-1` from the existing required lanes even if the advisory scanner workflow fails. Because the separate workflow cannot read `gerrit-verify.yaml`'s same-run `needs.classify.outputs.route`, it intentionally runs on every dispatched Gerrit patchset selected by the filename filter. That is acceptable for this advisory phase because it is outside the `Verified` workflow-conclusion snapshot and has no vote-casting authority.

## Testing

Use RED-first held-out TDD for the static/behavioral contract proving the Gerrit scanner workflow is separate from `gerrit-verify.yaml` and outside the `Verified` aggregate. Run the scanner installer/manifest/docs/workflow tests plus `tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py`, `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py`, and `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py`. Before final gates, rebase onto latest `origin/main`, regenerate docs, and verify `docs/config-reference.md` has no unexpected drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The reverted scanner artifacts are recreated/adapted within the recorded 21-path impact.
- [x] `review-scanners.lock.json` has independent linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 entries with exact Gitleaks URLs and SHA-256 values from release checksums.
- [x] Each platform entry points to a resolved Semgrep requirements lock with the same Semgrep version and required hashes; installer uses `pip install --require-hashes`.
- [x] Docker review-bot selects/validates linux/arm64; reusable Linux x64 CI selects/validates linux/amd64.
- [x] Installer rejects unsupported platform, missing scanner, wrong Gitleaks version/digest, and invalid Semgrep hashes before contracts run.
- [x] Valid locks allow explicit native scanner contracts; default local tests and unsupported local platforms skip with reasons and do not provision scanners.
- [x] A test verifies `bin/semgrep` remains executable when installation uses a relative `.tools/review-scanners` prefix from another working directory.
- [x] Generated `docs/security.md` names the manifest as update authority, checksum source, per-platform bump example, and withdrawn-asset recovery procedure.
- [x] Regeneration leaves `docs/config-reference.md` with no unexpected drift.
- [x] `_scanner-integration.yml` carries the b973 predates guard and the Make recipe is POSIX-dash-safe under the parity tests.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py` names `_scanner-integration.yml` and `gerrit-scanner-verify.yml`.
- [x] `scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py` documents `scanner-integration` as an ADR-0114 advisory exception.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` accepts explicitly justified scanner CI-step mechanisms without requiring baseline promotion.
- [x] Gerrit scanner wiring is non-voting/non-blocking: separate workflow, outside `gerrit-verify.yaml`, outside `vote.needs`, outside vote normalization, and outside required workflow-conclusion aggregation.
- [x] Mirror CI may run the reusable scanner lane for visibility, and the separate Gerrit advisory workflow may run on all dispatched patchsets, but Gerrit `Verified` voting remains governed only by the existing aggregate.
- [x] OpenGrep, Docker-image builds, normal `make lint`, and default local tests remain outside scope.
- [x] Cold-run cost is documented at about 1.5-3 runner-minutes without extending the 22-23 minute critical path when capacity is available.
